subject: Spark Symposium — inference priority & next steps
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Park <jamie@finely.ai>, Asha Verma <asha@dataforge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Spark Symposium — inference priority & next steps

Hi Jamie / Asha — great to meet you at Spark yesterday. Thanks again for the quick demo of the Finely ingestion pipeline — there are a few spots where lower-latency inference at scale could materially reduce customer friction (real-time labeling and batched scoring during ingestion).

Recap of what we heard from you: 
- Primary use: near-real-time inference on streaming data (sub-200ms p95 target)
- Expected 6–8M tokens/day initially, spiking during business hours
- Priority: accuracy for reranking + cost controls to stay within current infra budget

Suggested next steps: 
1) 30-minute technical sync (engineering + infra) to scope a pilot and confirm latency targets
2) Share security/compliance checklist so you can validate against your vendor requirements
3) Proposal for a 6-week pilot (Dedicated pool) with an initial eval prompt set

Can you confirm whether this is still a priority for you in Q4? If so, I can propose two slots next week (Nov 22–24) and loop in our solutions lead (Marissa) for the technical sync.

Attaching a short recap from our booth and a one-pager on Redwood Dedicated for pilots.

Attachments: spark-symposium-recap.pdf

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0147

From: Jamie Park <jamie@finely.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Spark Symposium — inference priority & next steps

Thanks Rachel — great meeting you too. Finely is definitely interested in reducing tail latency on our streaming scorer; the p95 target you mentioned aligns with our internal goals. Asha will be the technical owner on our side for the pilot.

Quick notes: 
- Priority for us is Q4 experimentation, with potential rollout in Q1 if pilot goes well
- Main security asks: SOC2 type II, SSO options, and data retention controls

I'm attaching the security questionnaire our procurement team uses so you can take a look and advise. We're also happy to do a short internal pre-qualification call before the technical sync.

Attachments: dataforge-security-questions.xlsx

Best,
Jamie Park
Head of Platform | Finely.ai
jamie@finely.ai | +1 646 555 0199

Subject: Quick priority check — pilot timing for Finely

Hi Jamie / Asha — circling back since I haven't seen a calendar pick from your team yet. Wanted to check whether pilot experimentation in Q4 is still the right priority, or if your roadmap has shifted into Q1.

If Q4 still works, two proposed 30-minute slots (PST):
- Tue Nov 23, 10:00–10:30 AM
- Wed Nov 24, 2:00–2:30 PM

If neither works, no problem — let me know a date range and we'll follow your cadence. To make scheduling easier, here's our HubSpot record and a short one-click DocuSign for a mutual NDA if you'd like to exchange any non-public prompts ahead of time: 
- HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/contacts/12345
- NDA: https://app.docusign.com/link/NDARedwoodFinely2026

If priorities shifted away from inference for now, a one-line update would be super helpful so we can re-engage at the right time. Looping in Sergio (partner team) to discuss potential marketplace listing if the pilot looks promising.

Thanks —
Rachel
